newsitem.title: USA: Intl Post holders back proposed merger.
newsitem.headline: Intl Post holders back proposed merger.

text.p: International Post Group Inc said Wednesday a majority of its stockholders plan to approve a proposed merger with privately-held Video Services Corp of Northvale, N.J.
It said company directors, executive officers and affiliates who hold 3.2 million shares, or 52 percent of the outstanding shares, will vote in favor of the previously-announced merger.
International Post will swap its seven million outstanding shares for all of Video Services, according to a company spokesman.

After the merger, Video Services will own more then 50 percent of the newly-formed company, which will be named Video Services Corp and will probably trade on Nasdaq under the symbol "VSCX", the spokesman said. He could not say when the merger will be completed.
On April 22, the company said the boards of both companies approved the merger, which was announced January 8.
International Post's stock traded at 3-1/8 Wednesday at midday, down 3/16.
